title: Craftable Nametags
description: IT IS A DATAPACK THAT ADDS CRAFTABLE NAMETAGS
body:
This datapack allows players to craft Name Tags in Minecraft, making it easier to name and personalize your favorite pets and mobs! No more searching for Name Tags in dungeons or fishing for hours—now you can create them with a simple crafting recipe. This datapack seamlessly integrates into your gameplay, keeping the game balanced while adding convenience for players who enjoy customizing their world.

Craft your Name Tags and give a unique identity to all your animals, villagers, and other creatures!
